title: Tampico Area Historical Society and Museum
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: OPEN by Appointment or by chance only. a few doors down from the Tampico Historical Society is the Reagan Birthplace, 111-113 Main St., which is open 7 days a week April-Oct. Monday through Saturday, 10:00 - 4:00 p.m. and Sunday, 1:00 - 4:00 p.m. The Birthplace staff can let you into the Historical Society building if they are not giving a tour. Contact president Joan Johnson to arrange a visit during "off" times.
